msg: warning: Variable newuri is used uninitialized!
reasoning: FALSE POSITIVE: dbafef17dd1.c (Apache rewrite). Alarm fires at line 11, columns 10-16 ('newuri' as the first argument to strncpy), when def(HAS_APACHE_REGEX_LIB). The tool claims 'newuri is used uninitialized,' but strncpy(dest, src, n) WRITES to its destination argument — it does not read the existing content of newuri. The real bug in this file is the off-by-one error at line 12 ('newuri[sizeof(newuri-1)]' should be 'newuri[sizeof(newuri)-1]'), but that is not what this alarm captures.
